newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Refrig. to offer bonus shares.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Refrig. to offer bonus shares.

text.p: Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor Co will offer three-for-10 bonus shares for all shareholders based on the firm's 1996 net profit, a company statement said on Monday.
The bonus issue was approved by shareholders at a meeting last Friday, the statement said.
The ex-rights date will be June 9, the statement said.
The blue-chip firm earlier posted a net profit of 109.79 million yuan for 1996 against 86.33 million yuan for 1995 based on international accounting standards.

After the bonus issue, the company will have a total of 422.6 million outstanding shares, composed of 162.1 million state shares, 60.8 million institutional shares, 179.4 million foreign currency B shares and 20.3 million domestic A shares, the statement said.
